Alex (runtime-eng): Nightly perf alert: p95 gen latency +12% on canary since 03:00. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/1769876 :eyes:
CI-bot: nightly-perf-check failed: regression detected on job `perf/throughput-latency` (base: abcde123 -> head: f12345b)
Marta (perf): I can repro locally with the long-seq chat workload. KV cache hit-rate drops from ~94% -> ~58% after head.
Raj (infra): That head contains the kernel-selection heuristics change (PR #3245) and the batching window tweak (PR #3251) that merged yesterday.
Marta (perf): Flamegraph looks different — way more time in the fallback GEMM path (quant-fallback) and in `kv_evict()` while batching stalls. Link: https://s3.redwood/fg/1769876.svg
Alex (runtime-eng): Reproduced with: `./tools/perf_run --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --rps 50 --duration 120` — latency spikes during warmup when evictions start.
Oncall (eng): CI perf job also shows ~8% tail increase. Job: https://ci.redwood/job/987/perf
Marta (perf): nvprof snapshot: fallback kernel launched ~3x more often; kernel selector picked int8-optimized kernel but quant path falls back for some seq shapes. Current conf dump: `KERNEL_SELECTOR=experimental_v2,BATCH_WINDOW=5ms`.
Alex (runtime-eng): Quick mitigation: flip `KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_v1` via canary flag and re-run nightly. If that fixes, revert PR #3245.
Raj (infra): I can patch canary to disable experimental selector for canary hosts. Pushing change now.
CI-bot: perf/throughput-latency rerun queued (job 988).
Marta (perf): Also proposing a temporary KV tweak to reduce churn: `kv_cache.max_items=200000` — should lower eviction pressure during warmup.
Alex (runtime-eng): Action items: 1) Raj apply canary flag 2) Marta run canary perf 3) If green, open revert PR for #3245 4) Follow-up: make selector consider KV hit impact / eviction cost.
Raj (infra): Flag applied to canary. Rerun triggered.
CI-bot: job 988 finished: p95 back to baseline, throughput within noise.
Marta (perf): Rerun eviction metrics: hit-rate restored to ~92%. Looks like selector change was the main culprit. :tada:
Alex (runtime-eng): OK — hold the experimental selector rollout and open revert PR: https://git.redwood/revert/PR_3301
Oncall (eng): Marking the release as a blocker for morning triage. Thanks everyone for the quick loop.
